node.title: Granular padding peaks in graphs
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext: I'm padding peaks in my graphs. In order to show the entire peak, not just the tip. purely aesthetics. my $maxYaxis = $peak + ( $peak * .1 ); My problem: as the peaks grow larger, so does the padding. And when they shrink, so does the padding. I'm seeking help with an algorithm to do granular padding.
